Same PR-v3 spine-sign defect class as 26 poses fixed in cron-round-4 (this pose missed by audit).

defects.claim: Place both hands behind you on the tube edge for support

Should be BEHIND body (z < hips z, ideally z < 0). shoulderFwdL:-10, shoulderFwdR:-10 — NEGATIVE = FORWARD per corrected convention, arms go wrong direction. Wrists far from under shoulders: L wrist x=-0.703 vs L shoulder x=-0.194 (0.509 to figure-left); R wrist x=0.794 vs R shoulder x=0.238 (0.556 to figure-right). Tip: wrists directly under shoulders.

regression_risk: Low-Medium — 6 field changes, all sign corrections or modest magnitude tweaks. PR-v3 spine flip is unambiguous (description says back, not forward). globalTilt +20→0 is also clearcut. Arm sign flip (shoulderFwd -→+) is sign-correct but wrist-final-position needs re-render verification. Legs preserved, no contact regression expected.
rationale: PR-v3 mis-fire confirmed by source comment: description clearly says LEAN THE TORSO BACK (backward = negative spine), but PR-v3 flipped spine -20→+20 based on misreading as forward lean. Cron-round-4 fixed 26 similar PR-v3 spine-sign defects but missed this pose. Also globalTilt:+20 wrong (should be 0 for seated-upright; +20=PRONE tilt). And shoulderFwd:-10/-10 wrong sign (negative=FORWARD per corrected convention; description requires hands BEHIND body on tube edge = positive shoulderFwd). Fixes: (1) spine +20 → -15 (flip back to negative for torso back-lean). (2) globalTilt +20 → 0 (body upright on tube). (3) shoulderFwd -10 → +15 (positive=BEHIND, hands reach back to tube edge). (4) Slight elbow increase 30/12 → 40/40 (forearms angle down to tube edge). Legs preserved (L hip 40° extended forward, R hip 95° bent with foot on tube — matches description). Sign conventions verified.
